5.  25-53983  Recommendation to discuss the Parks and Recreation Commission
  subcommittees.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Livingstone, seconded by Vice
  Chair Uriarte Smith, to approve recommendation, as amended, to (1)
  dissolve the Executive Committee and the Finance and Appeals
  Committee and combine into one new committee named as the
  Governance Committee; (2) dissolve the Public Safety and Parks Usage
  Committee; (3) dissolve the Marketing and Recreation Committee; (4)
  change the name of the Maintenance and Infrastructure Committee to
  Maintenance, Infrastructure and Planning Committee; (5) dissolve the
  standing Joint Use Committee and create a new Ad Hoc Committee
  related to Joint Use of Facilities with LBUSD. The motion carried by the
